blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Thursday said the government is ready to be audited over its P22.9-billion allocation for the Philippines’ hosting of the 48th and 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits this year. This amount is notably higher than the P3.79 billion spent during the Philippines’ hosting of the Asean Summits in 2017 under the administration of former President Rodrigo Duterte and the P1 billion spent in 2007 during the term of former President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo. According to Palace press officer Claire Castro, the government has already completed 393 Asean-related meetings, with another 164 scheduled. […]...
